important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual - a Young Professional shall not be regarded as a 'staff member' or 'official' of CSB, and no employer-employee relationship is established Engagement is initially for 2 years, extendable based on performance evaluation and approval of the Member Secretary, CSB The engaged candidate must mandatorily complete the "Dakshta for Young Professionals" course on iGOT within 2 months of joining Working hours are generally 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM with a half-hour lunch break; late sitting or working on holidays during exigencies will not attract additional remuneration Paid leave is granted at 1.5 days per completed month; leave cannot be accumulated beyond the calendar year, and absence for up to one month may be considered without remuneration (paid on pro-rata basis) Women Young Professionals may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 The engagement can be terminated by either party with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu thereof; CSB reserves the right to terminate immediately for serious failure to perform or breach of conduct Engagement is subject to verification of educational and experience documents; false or incorrect information will lead to immediate termination and further action as per rules Candidates must submit a police verification report and a medical-cum-fitness certificate from an authorised Medical Practitioner prior to engagement The period of engagement will not confer any claim or right to subsequent employment with CSB or any other Government Department Any dispute or grievance is to be addressed to the Member Secretary, Central Silk Board, and settled as per the Contract's grievance/arbitration provisions

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications received after 7 October 2026 will not be entertained. No separate online application start date is mentioned - candidates can email their application any time before the last date.

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Vacancy 2026 – Post & Location Details
content_sections.text: There are 14 vacancies for Young Professional-Grade-3, distributed across CSB's Central Office and its Institutes/Units as follows.

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

rows.details: Chartered Accountant with 3+ years of experience in Government sector, OR MBA/M.Com with 5+ years of experience in Government sector
Government accounting of autonomous bodies, Tally Prime, procurement procedures in Government, scrutiny of TA/DA bills, medical bills, pension, internal audit, and statutory compliances

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

Remuneration may be enhanced annually based on performance: In no case shall the remuneration of any Young Professional exceed 1.35 times the initial remuneration. While on tour, TA/DA will be admissible as per Level-8 employees.

content_sections.heading: CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be carried out as per existing CSB guidelines by a Screening Committee, followed by a Selection Committee constituted with the approval of the Competent Authority. The Selection Committee will also empanel a waiting list of candidates, valid for one year in addition to the finally selected candidates. No written examination is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download and fill the application in the prescribed Annexure-I format, covering Personal Information, Educational Qualification, and Experience details Attach self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets of educational qualification, experience certificates from past employers (and a certificate from the current employer, if applicable), and documents for other relevant details Sign the undertaking declaring that all information provided is true and complete Email the completed application along with the required documents to [email protected] Ensure your application reaches CSB on or before the last date of 07/10/2026 - applications received after this date will not be entertained

faq.question: Q1. What is CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. CSB/YP/03/2026 issued by the Central Silk Board for 14 Young Professional-Grade-3 posts on a contractual basis at its Central Office and Institutes/Units across India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies - 4 at the CSB Central Office, Bengaluru, and 1 each at 10 CSB Institutes/Units across India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach CSB via email by 7 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CSB Young Professional?
faq.answer: A Chartered Accountant with 3+ years of government-sector experience, or an MBA/M.Com with 5+ years of government-sector experience, in areas like government accounting, Tally Prime, procurement, and audit/compliance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill the Annexure-I application format, attach self-attested documents, and email it to [email protected] by 7 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSB Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is done by a Screening Committee and a Selection Committee as per CSB guidelines; no written exam is mentioned.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for CSB Young Professional?
faq.answer: Selected candidates get ₹70,000/- per month, inclusive of all applicable taxes, with possible annual performance-based enhancement up to 10%.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSB Young Professional post a permanent job?
faq.answer: No - it is a purely contractual engagement, initially for 2 years, extendable based on performance; it does not confer any claim to subsequent employment with CSB or any other Government Department.
